cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under themes preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is displayed as in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display against reference image
cases.description: Navigate to the Modern theme and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item availability under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the Get New Themes item is available and present.

cases.title: Verify Classic item is available under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and confirm that the 'Modern' menu item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are clear, distinct, and cover all requirements correctly.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario includes navigating to theme preferences and verifying the existence of both Classic and Modern themes. For R-176: Normal scenario includes verifying that the Classic theme is displayed according to the given image. For R-177: Normal scenario includes verifying that the Modern theme is displayed according to the given image. For R-178: Normal scenario includes checking that the Theme Preferences item is available under the View menu. For R-179: Normal scenario includes checking that the Get New Themes item is available under the View menu. For R-180: Normal scenario includes checking that the Classic item is available under the View menu. For R-181: Normal scenario includes checking that the Modern item is available under the View menu. All speculative scenarios involving empty theme lists, network failures, resolution adjustments, and high-contrast settings have been removed to strictly align with the stated requirements.
